contract_errata: v1.0.1 makes finalized_position_results required in emitted accounting state
v1.0.1 removes unimplemented Option D placeholders from v1 runtime required fields
v1.0.1 requires replay-stable backtest identities independent of random decision UUIDs
v1.2.0 clarifies atomic in-memory restore, terminal-before-trade reconciliation and canonical open-intent snapshots without changing the frozen experiment

units_and_pnl_normalization.pnl_raw_points: fee-inclusive point-lots calculated from actual fill prices; adverse slippage is already represented by fill prices and must not be deducted again
units_and_pnl_normalization.daily_realized: sum of normalized close-fill point-lots assigned to each RB risk session
units_and_pnl_normalization.drawdown: ratio of account-currency equity to account-currency peak equity

normalizer.compatibility_reason: matches the current backtest risk update boundary

units_and_pnl_normalization.fill_accounting_order: normalize each close fill, then update realized_points and daily_realized
units_and_pnl_normalization.position_result_order: sum raw close-fill PnL for one position, then normalize once for win/loss/flat

fill_id.backtest: deterministic synthetic ID derived from replay-stable position_id, close leg and fill sequence; random decision UUIDs are forbidden identity inputs

position_id.rule: created once for the logical position on its first open fill and retained through all partial fills until quantity becomes zero
position_id.backtest_derivation: stable event, Setup, contract, entry timestamp, entry bar, fill price and direction inputs; excludes random decision_id
new_identity_events: reversal open leg after the prior position is finalized
rollover open on the replacement contract

ordered_effects: advance risk session before PnL mutation
append raw and normalized PnL to the active position aggregator
persist the accepted fill ID and accounting state in the same runtime-state commit

finalize_position.trigger: position quantity after applying an accepted close fill is exactly zero
ordered_effects: reject a duplicate finalized position_id without mutation
read completed raw PnL from the internal active position aggregator
normalize the aggregate once with python_round_1dp_v1
apply an Option D transition when the position belongs to a probe epoch
move position_id to finalized tombstones and persist in the same runtime-state commit

rules: preserve the existing first authoritative oms_balance observation rebasing behavior
update peak only from valid positive finite account-currency values
scope is audit metadata and is not itself a gate input
do not mutate realized PnL, daily PnL, position aggregates or streak

runtime_state.option_d_schema_policy: the accounting-only profiles continue to emit open005-risk-runtime-v1 without option_d fields; D_EXPERIMENT emits open005-risk-runtime-v2 with option_d and reserved_intents
runtime_state.atomicity: accepted fill accounting, position finalization, Option D transition and the versioned runtime snapshot form one logical commit; an implementation without transactional storage must fail closed and reconcile broker fill IDs on recovery
runtime_state.restore_atomicity: a rejected or invalid runtime snapshot must leave the already-running in-memory RiskManager state unchanged
runtime_state.storage_boundary: vn.py variable persistence is not an operating-system transactional file commit; a crash during persistence must block new exposure and require OMS plus broker fill-ID reconciliation
runtime_state.canonical_probe_intent_snapshot: backtest, CTA and pre-release live paths persist the post-transition open-order intent view: action is open_long or open_short and signed target_position equals the open-leg quantity

semantics.enforce: evaluate, emit an enforced breach when breached, and block the exposure-increasing leg
semantics.observe: evaluate and emit an observed breach when breached, but do not block
semantics.disabled: do not evaluate the gate and do not emit a breach

risk_gate_evaluation.evaluation_rule: evaluate every enabled state gate without first-breach short-circuit
risk_gate_evaluation.approved_rule: approved only when every hard prerequisite passes and enforced_breaches is empty
risk_gate_evaluation.compatibility_reason: the legacy reason string is the first hard failure or first enforced breach in stable order
risk_gate_evaluation.naming_rule: risk gate observe mode must never be named shadow mode

B0_UNINTERRUPTED_STRATEGY_PATH.purpose: diagnose the strategy path without account-state gate truncation; this is not pure alpha

B1_CONSECUTIVE_LOSS_ABLATION.purpose: single-gate causal control for Option D

D_EXPERIMENT.purpose: evaluate Option D against B1 while keeping every non-consecutive-loss gate identical

rules: flat to nonzero produces only an open leg
nonzero to flat produces only a close leg
same-sign lower absolute target produces only a close leg
same-sign higher absolute target produces only an open leg
opposite-sign target produces a close-to-zero leg followed by a separately approved open-from-zero leg
position_transition.approval_boundary: state gates apply only to the open or exposure-increasing leg; a close or exposure-reducing leg bypasses account-state entry gates but still obeys execution integrity checks
position_transition.forbidden_shortcut: the sign of order quantity alone must not classify an entire reversal as risk reducing

option_d.reservation_rule: one active probe reservation per probe_epoch_id; bind existing order IDs to a persisted recoverable intent identity; when any terminal order report, including ALLTRADED, advertises traded volume before trade callbacks arrive, persist reported_fill_order_ids and retain the reservation until fill reconciliation
option_d.late_fill_rule: an open fill arriving after a zero-fill terminal rejection is not applied to strategy or risk state; it must mark recovery required and be reconciled against broker and OMS state before new exposure
option_d.availability_rule: after eligible_from_session is reached, unused probe availability persists across later sessions until a first open fill or an explicit policy reset

effects: set paused_at_session to the finalization risk session
set eligible_from_session to the next valid RB trading session
create one probe_epoch_id if none exists
reserve intent identity
bind probe order IDs
reject a second reservation
release reservation
retain probe_epoch_id and availability
bind probe_position_id
consume availability
retain in-flight state after partial fill and cancellation of the remainder
close probe epoch
set paused_at_session to the finalization risk session
set eligible_from_session to the next valid RB trading session
cancel an unsubmitted reversal open leg
close probe epoch
set paused_at_session to the finalization risk session
set eligible_from_session to the next valid RB trading session
cancel an unsubmitted reversal open leg
close probe epoch

steps: decompose reversal into close-to-zero and open-from-zero legs
allow the close leg regardless of state-gate breaches
after quantity becomes zero, finalize the old position
apply the resulting streak and Option D state transition
re-evaluate the pending reversal open leg against the new risk state
submit the open leg only if the new evaluation approves it
reversal_ordering.must_not_reuse: a risk approval made before the close leg
reversal_ordering.market_intent_rule: OPEN-005 does not redefine the existing signal expiry or structural validity policy; the stored reversal intent must still pass all existing non-risk validity checks

parity_invariants.B0: risk audit fields may differ, but decisions, fills and trades must exactly match a reference run with the same four state gates disabled
parity_invariants.B1: all inputs and behavior except max_consecutive_losses enforcement must match CURRENT_ENFORCED
parity_invariants.runtime: backtest, CTA and live must share event ordering, PnL normalization and position-transition decomposition

implementation_order: validate this contract and its test matrix
implement risk accounting events and persistence with legacy exact parity
implement risk gate modes and B0/B1
run B0/B1 without changing Option D
implement the frozen experimental Option D
compare Option D only against B1
